projects.name: Personal Website
projects.description: Personal site and blog with a few projects and an email signup. Built with Astro and Tailwind CSS, with one React island for the navigation.
notes: Static site with Markdown blog posts and an RSS feed.
Email signup is a plain form that posts to Kit.

projects.name: Pangu Terminal
projects.description: Progression planner and farming optimizer for Wuthering Waves. Tracks the materials you need against your inventory, shows what you can craft instead of farm, and prioritizes what is left to farm.
notes: Ruby on Rails app with a REST API and an LLM-based farming advisor.
Runs on a free tier, so it can take up to a minute to wake after sitting idle.

projects.name: LunrFast
projects.description: A calm intermittent fasting app for iOS and Android: a timer that is never paywalled, a simple food log, and small private circles for fasting together. Personal health data stays on the phone, encrypted.
notes: Built with Expo, React Native and TypeScript, with encrypted on-device storage.
Supabase backs the private circles feature.
In development: fasting, food log and circles are built; device testing and release reviews are still open.
